Browse the [Shiny gallery](shiny-gallery.html){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} in a new tab, or
run the examples here alongside their R source. The first launch downloads R
and its dependencies. The apps use the highcharter version documented here.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(htmltools)
demo <- function(slug, title, height = 450) {
  src <- file.path("..", "pkgdown", "shiny", slug, "app.R")
  url <- paste0("../live/", slug, "/index.html")
  tagList(
    tags$div(
      class = "shiny-app-frame",
      tags$iframe(
        title = title,
        src = url,
        class = paste0("shiny-app-", slug),
        loading = "lazy",
        width = "100%",
        height = height,
        style = "border:0"
      )
    ),
    tags$pre(tags$code(
      class = "language-r",
      paste(readLines(src), collapse = "\n")
    )),
    tags$p(tags$a(
      href = url,
      "Open the app in its own tab",
      target = "_blank",
      rel = "noopener"
    ))
  )
}
```

## Basics

Select **Sepal** or **Petal**. The same 150 flowers move to their new coordinates.
Put `highchartOutput("flowers")` in the UI and read `input$measure` inside
`renderHighchart()` to rebuild the plot when the measurement changes.

```{r basic, echo=FALSE}
demo("basic", "the iris explorer")
```

## Proxies

Start with twelve months of air passenger counts. **Add a month** appends one
observation with `hcpxy_add_point()`. **Columns** changes the series type with
`hcpxy_update_series()`. Switch back to **Line** and your added months are
still there. Both controls target the series ID `traffic` through
`highchartProxy("passengers", session)`.

```{r proxy, echo=FALSE}
demo("proxy", "the passenger chart")
```

To switch from weekly to daily Stock prices when the visible date range narrows, [run the Stock proxy app](../live/stock/index.html) or
[read the Stock walkthrough](stock.html#update-a-series-and-its-visible-range-in-shiny).

## Events

Each lit segment adds 1 dB to the band's gain, starting at −12 dB.
Hover over a band, click it, then drag its top and release it. Each event has
its own readout. The `drag` and `mouseOver` values refresh at most once every
150 ms. The `drop` value shows the final gain as soon as you release the band.

```{r events, echo=FALSE}
demo("events", "the equalizer", height = 595)
```

Point clicks arrive automatically at `input$eq_point_click`. Register
`mouseOver`, `drag` and `drop` with `hc_add_event_point()` to receive their
inputs too. For example, `input$eq_point_mouseOver$pointid` identifies the
band under the pointer and `input$eq_point_drag$y` gives its gain during a drag.

## Linked views

The dotplot shows mean petal length by species, rounded to the nearest
millimeter. With `colorByPoint = TRUE`, each species gets its own color.
Pause over a species for 200 ms or click it for an immediate selection. The
detail shows petal length and width for its 50 flowers in the same color.
A Shiny proxy updates the detail points, series
color and title while keeping the axes fixed for comparison.

```{r linked, echo=FALSE}
demo("linked", "the linked charts", height = 400)
```

To run an example from a local checkout, load the package and open the app directory:

```{r local-app, eval=FALSE}
pkgload::load_all()
shiny::runApp("pkgdown/shiny/events")
```

The [original Shiny examples](https://github.com/jbkunst/highcharter-shiny)
include the full [proxy playground](https://github.com/jbkunst/highcharter-shiny/tree/master/02-proxy-functions)
and a [population explorer with linked views](https://github.com/jbkunst/highcharter-shiny/tree/master/08-idb-viz).
